source.name: Natural Earth 1:10m admin 0 countries with lakes and disputed-area exclusions
source.simplification_note: Topology-preserving tolerance in source lon/lat plane; <= approximately 48m surface displacement including coordinate rounding; source cartographic accuracy is separate.
source.coordinate_decimal_places: 5, or original 6 where required to retain valid topology

scope.spain: Mainland and Balearic Islands only; excludes Canaries, Ceuta, Melilla and African possessions.
scope.france: Metropolitan France including Corsica; excludes overseas territories.
scope.norway: Mainland and coastal islands; excludes Svalbard and Jan Mayen.
scope.usa: 48 contiguous states, Alaska including Aleutians, and Hawaii; excludes dependencies and territories.
scope.other_europe: Selected country polygons including their European islands; Portuguese Azores and Madeira are included. Dependencies with separate Natural Earth features are not included.
scope.exclusions: Both Natural Earth disputed-area polygon layers are subtracted; original country holes and mapped lakes are retained. Small unmapped water/features can remain due to source scale.
scope.boundary_distance: Approximate local equirectangular distance to all polygon boundaries, including coast, islands, lakes and excluded holes. This is not a legal boundary survey or an RF-coverage estimate; a 2km caller guard also blocks narrow coastal/island areas.
scope.land_boundary_distance: Separate Natural Earth international boundary-line geometry for supported countries, including Water Indicator international lines but excluding coastlines. Runtime distance is capped at 6km: 6 means at least 6km from the mapped line, not a surveyed distance. A caller may use a 2km international-border margin separately from a smaller coast/polygon-edge margin. Source cartographic accuracy is separate from simplification.
scope.regulatory_mapping: Country codes map to documentary Meshtastic EU_868 or US region; no local mesh RF preset is inferred.
scope.network: No network or IP lookup at runtime.
scope.known_micro_enclaves: Natural Earth does not resolve every small enclave. Conservative manual-only policy circles of radius10km exclude Baarle, Buesingen, Llivia and Campione. These are deliberately broad safety policies, not claimed administrative boundaries. Circle centre coordinates come from the pinned Wikidata CC0 dataset records, not the Natural Earth country geometry.
